أبو القاسم عبد الله بن أحمد بن العامر الطائي

notes: «في منزله بمرورود» and «بالبصرة» are places, not links; the leading «2 -» is the report number
«الفقيهالمرورودي» is written without a space in the text: read as one name, as written
«أبي» under Abu al-Qasim is his father (relation); «أبي موسى بن جعفر» etc. are «أبي» plus a name, one link each (rule 7)
the level «علي» is bare in the text where the chain would run through al-Husayn: read as written, not completed (rule 9)
the Companion Ali relays the Prophet's words: last link
